why: a spec where every step names a visible result passes
thin seed data, empty out-of-scope and a vague result warn but do not block
a step with no result and a health value that is not a path must block
an unreadable file is bad input, not a pass
no input must refuse, never fall back to the sample
a mistyped flag is bad input; argparse's default exit 2 would read as WARN
--sample must not silently replace a real file
